name: awaria
description: Outage notifier — Tauri desktop & Android app

scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run test:android
scripts.kill:em:all: taskkill /f /im cargo.exe & taskkill /f /im rustc.exe & taskkill /f /im rust-analyzer.exe
scripts.build:install: npx tauri android build --target aarch64 --apk && adb install D:/eremef/Documents/AI/antigravity/awaria/src-tauri/gen/android/app/build/outputs/apk/universal/release/app-universal-release.apk
scripts.logcat: powershell -Command "$AppPid = adb shell pidof -s xyz.eremef.awaria; if ($AppPid) { adb logcat -v color --pid=$AppPid } else { Write-Host 'App is not running!' -ForegroundColor Red }"
